data.name: Awla
data.gender_notes: Awla is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'awwala', which means 'to be near' or 'dear one'. In Islamic culture, it is often given to a child who is a beloved one or the nearest in age or relationship. The name Awla carries the meaning “Nearest or dear one” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Awla usually hope their child will grow to embody nearest or dear one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Awla total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
